test_head_A_tray.notes: Pair with test_head_A_sand and the head A D-foot sample. Seat sand, then lower the whole D-pins through the larger passages into the tray. The cream foot shoulder should meet the sand without rocking.

test_head_A_sand.notes: Actual head-A sand passages; four small carrier pads preserve the full insert bearing height. Visible face down, sockets up.

test_base_join_left.notes: Close the matching two flat seam faces completely, then drop in the production-shaped join key from the open top. Flat faces set the seam; the key is a glue locator.

test_base_join_right.notes: Close the matching two flat seam faces completely, then drop in the production-shaped join key from the open top. Flat faces set the seam; the key is a glue locator.

test_base_join_key.notes: Close the tray seam fully, drop this key into the open-top pocket, then glue. Add sand after joining the trays. No blind bridged slot.

test_sand_register_tray.notes: Actual round sand registration boss. Pair with test_sand_register_insert; it should seat fully with light finger pressure.

test_sand_register_insert.notes: Actual blind registration socket. Small carrier pads reproduce the production underside datum. Print ground face down.

test_slide_2_shell.notes: Exact full production slide2 shell in the actual colour and supported orientation; reusable in the final model. Test the complete rigid insertion path and seating lands after carefully removing supports. Keep dry until the fit is accepted.

test_slide_2_insert.notes: Exact full production slide2 insert in the actual colour and supported orientation; reusable in the final model. Test the complete rigid insertion path and seating lands after carefully removing supports. Keep dry until the fit is accepted.

geometry_mode: delivered STL triangles in saved assembly poses
limits: No physical glue or clamp test.
A cradle with 0.15 mm side allowance can permit up to about 0.30 mm relative lateral movement between loose halves.
Angular and insertion probes are sampled geometric screens, not a physical clamp or assembly test.
